newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAPELLO AIMS TO COACH FOR THREE MORE YEARS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAPELLO AIMS TO COACH FOR THREE MORE YEARS.

text.p: Fabio Capello, the former AC Milan manager who has said he will leave Spanish league leaders Real Madrid at the end of the season, plans to coach for three more years.
"I want to do it for another three years, and then ....as a commentator or in any other post of some club," said Capello in an interview in the Spanish daily "El Mundo" on Wednesday.
Capello has been widely linked with his former club since announcing he would leave Real.
He said in the newspaper he would advise Real chairman Lorenzo Sanz over the choice of a new coach, if he were asked.
In Wednesday's sports daily "Marca", Sanz quashed rumours that Capello may stay at Real after all.
"The Italian coach will not continue here. I have no doubt, but until after (Saturday's game with) Barcelona, I will not say more," said Sanz.
Capello also said in the interview that until recently he had been working on Real's signings for next season, including that of Zaragoza's Fernando Morientes.
The comment seemed to confirm recent speculation linking the young striker with Real.
